name: Charwood Energy S.A.
summary: Established in 2006 and headquartered in Saint-Nolff, France, Charwood Energy S.A. focuses on the entire lifecycle of biomass-fueled power stations, from their conceptual design and construction to installation and ongoing operation. The company operates as an autonomous electricity generator while also managing power facilities on behalf of other organizations. Its diverse client base includes industrial businesses, local government entities, and agricultural ventures.
